record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: IMPIDIMP, MORGREM and GRIMMSNARL (the queued units, the whole evolution line).
record.summary: Single-target special damage (20 raw at 1 star, 40 at 2, 80 at 3) followed by a -20 requested ability-power change on the same target. The AP change is applied whether or not the damage was blocked or killed the target; it is scaled by the caster's AP, can be turned into an Attack loss by Nullify Bandanna or into a buff by Twist Band, and AP cannot drop below -100.

effects.scaling: requested amount: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (6th argument apBoost = true); crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: applied amount: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (no damage; the AP debuff below is still applied). takenDamage (which includes shield damage) is not used by this ability

declaredRaw.note: requested amount, a constant independent of stars

effects.scaling: requested -20 x (1 + caster AP / 100) x (critPower if the cast crit), rounded (apBoost 1): a caster with AP makes the debuff larger, and a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT) larger again
effects.resolution: applied amount: Big Eater Belt does not apply to this enemy debuff (helper only affects positive values or same-team negatives); TWIST_BAND on the target flips it into a gain of the same size; NULLIFY_BANDANNA on the target replaces it by an Attack change of round(0.2 x -20) = -4 (the AP scaling, helpers and the clamp are skipped); otherwise target AP = max(-100, AP + value). Applied after the damage call regardless of its result, so a protected or just-killed target still receives it

starBehavior.note: damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entry 160 and the fallback 160 are not reached by these units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). The -20 AP change has no star dependence. maxPP is 70 and range 1 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target in the caster's range.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept on the caster: each cast deals damage and applies another -20 (scaled) AP change to the target, so repeated casts on the same target stack until the -100 AP floor. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw) damage: 20 (IMPIDIMP, 1 star) / 40 (MORGREM, 2 stars) / 80 (GRIMMSNARL, 3 stars). Applied damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; takenDamage is not used. Requested AP change: -20; applied AP change = round(-20 x (1 + caster AP/100) [x critPower]) unless Twist Band (sign flipped), Nullify Bandanna (Attack -4 instead) or the -100 AP floor changes it.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
Target selection and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, canCast, range, movement)
Crit chance resolution (only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read)
unresolved: Effect of a lower target AP on the target's own abilities and healing was not traced (the AP stat is only changed here; its consumers are other records)
